name: Hyperion

abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Physical Resistance: Fiziksel hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Güç kazanımını kontrol etmek en önemlisi — nötralize, güç çalma/çekme veya petrify efektli şampiyon kullan.
signatureAbility:
Cosmic Potential
Hyperion's Eternal physiology becomes more efficient at storing and converting cosmic radiation, resulting in [52 - 75]% increased Fury, Precision, Power Gain and Regeneration Buff duration.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Eternal physiology grants immunity to all known poisons within the Battlerealm.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: 40% chance to gain a Fury Buff for 10 seconds, granting +[5,749.2] Attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: This attack Incinerates the enemy, dealing [9,965.28] Energy Damage over 10 seconds. This effect also removes Perfect Block Chance and reduces Block Proficiency by 50% while it's active.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: 100% chance to inflict an Armor Break Debuff, removing 1 Armor Up Buff and reducing Armor Rating by [2,250] for 15 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% chance to gain up to 3 Cosmic Charges.
If Hyperion has 3 Cosmic Charges when used he instead gains a Cosmic Overcharge Buff.
While in Cosmic Overcharge mode Hyperion gains Power, and does not convert Cosmic Charges into Power Gains while below Full Power.

abilitySections.title: Cosmic Charge - Passive
content: Each charge passively increases Physical Resistance by [798.39].
Each charge passively increases Attack by [4,791].
Whenever not at full Power, Cosmic Charges are converted into Power Gain Buffs, 1 at a time.

abilitySections.title: Cosmic Healing - Passive
content: Hyperion triggers Cosmic Healing by dashing backwards and holding block for 2 seconds, at a cost of 3 Cosmic Charges.
Cosmic Healing Regenerates [21,849] of Hyperion's Health over 15 seconds.
After triggering Cosmic Healing, Hyperion will be unable to generate Cosmic Charges for 45 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Cosmic Potential
content: Hyperion's Eternal physiology becomes more efficient at storing and converting cosmic radiation, resulting in [52 - 75]% increased Fury, Precision, Power Gain and Regeneration Buff duration.
